hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rb|*.rake|*.ru|*.gemspec|*.jbuilder|*/Gemfile|*/Rakefile) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -x bin/rubocop ] || exit 0; out=$(bin/rubocop -a --force-exclusion --format simple "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'RuboCop offenses remain after autocorrect in %s:\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); g='(^|[;&|[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+'; printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq "${g}commit" || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -x bin/rubocop ] || exit 0; set -- '*.rb' '*.rake' '*.ru' '*.gemspec' '*.jbuilder' Gemfile Rakefile; add=0; all=0; printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq "${g}add([[:space:]]|$)" && add=1; printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq "${g}commit([^;&|]*[[:space:]](-[a-zA-Z]*a[a-zA-Z]*|--all))" && all=1; { git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -z -- "$@"; if [ $add = 1 ] || [ $all = 1 ]; then git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -z -- "$@"; fi; if [ $add = 1 ]; then git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z -- "$@"; fi; } | sort -zu | xargs -0 -r bin/rubocop --force-exclusion --format simple >&2 || { echo 'Pre-commit: RuboCop offenses in files being committed. Run bin/rubocop -a, re-stage, then commit.' >&2; exit 2; }; if [ -x bin/brakeman ]; then bin/brakeman --quiet --no-pager --no-summary --exit-on-warn --exit-on-error >&2 || { echo 'Pre-commit: Brakeman reported warnings. Fix or add to config/brakeman.ignore before committing.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi

command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+push' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -x bin/ci ] || exit 0; bin/ci >&2 || { echo 'Pre-push: bin/ci failed. Fix the failing step before pushing.' >&2; exit 2; }
command -v notify-send >/dev/null || exit 0; notify-send 'Claude Code' "$(jq -r '.message // "Needs your attention"' 2>/dev/null)" || true
